newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NW Australia may see one more cyclone - bureau.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NW Australia may see one more cyclone - bureau.

text.p: The potential for at least one further tropical cyclone to form off Australia's northwest coast this season remained high, the Bureau of Meteorology said on Friday.
The next active monsoon period for waters off northwest Australia would be toward the end of March or in early April, it said in a statement.
This was expected to be the final episode for the season after a very active monsoon period across north-western Australia this season, it said.
The cyclone season is a summer phenomenon.
A total of seven cyclones formed in the Perth Tropical Cyclone Warning Centre area of responsibility, which includes the Cocos Islands, the bureau said.
Four cyclones had occurred off the northwest Australian coast, two of which crossed the coast. These were cyclone Nicholas in December and cyclone Rachel in January.
A number of offshore petroleum facilities have been forced to temporarily shut-in by the threat of approaching cyclones this season.
